title: MITRE T1195 Software Supply Chain & Dependency Compromise Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate Compromised Vendor Binary, Package, or CI/CD Alert
steps.description: Verify affected package version, SHA-256 checksum, digital signature, or vendor advisory.

steps.activity_name: Inventory SBOM & Enterprise Deployment Blast Radius
steps.description: Query SBOM, CI/CD pipelines, build runners, and endpoint inventory for the tainted component.

steps.activity_name: Hunt Post-Installation C2, Secret Access & Build Tampering
steps.description: Correlate DNS/proxy egress, environment variable reads, and artifact signing logs from affected hosts.

steps.activity_name: Quarantine Tainted Builds, Pin Clean Versions & Rotate CI Secrets
steps.description: Conditional containment when active compromise or secret exposure is confirmed.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Verify Clean Rebuild Integrity & Close Supply Chain Incident
steps.description: Document verified clean deployment hash and vendor remediation status.
